cause_quote: The initial pasted-text chip called `void this.loadExcerpt(this.src, controller);` in `willUpdate` as soon as a source was available, with no viewport or focus check.
user_saw: Scrolling attachment-heavy chat history triggered extra metadata requests and pasted-text excerpt downloads for chips far outside the viewport.
summary: The fix defers metadata resolution for pasted-text and grouped comment chips until they approach the viewport or receive focus, which also delays pasted-text excerpt downloads.
reasoning: The pasted-text chip's introducing diff resolves its source during rendering and starts an excerpt read as soon as that source is available. The grouped-comment path independently shipped eager metadata resolution in #148649 while already gating body reads on reveal. I checked that #155623 added viewport deferral for other attachment cards while preserving the existing eager behavior for text chips.
